provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Santorini rules (Roxley / Spin Master, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Cliff Pedestal on the Ocean Board, Island Board on top
God Powers: the Challenger picks one per player and reads them out; clockwise each player takes one, the Challenger gets the last
steps.note: With 3-4 players check that each God Power is compatible

steps.text: The youngest player places 2 Workers on any free spaces, then the others place theirs
The Challenger picks a Start Player, who places 2 Workers; the others place theirs clockwise
On your turn move one Worker, then build with it
